title: Convert EN 1997 Norm Crate to Declarative Dsl Engine
description: Convert norm/en/1997/rs (norm_en_1997) from its hand-rolled vcs::DocumentDsl/vcs::OpText (dsl_kv-based) implementation onto the new declarative dsl_schema/dsl_derive engine (dsl::DslDocument / dsl::DslScalar derives), matching the pattern already used in norm/en/1992/rs. Add a `dsl = { path = "../../../../dsl/rs" }` dependency, derive dsl::DslDocument on Document with #[dsl(extension = "en1997", layout = "lines")], use #[dsl(ident)] for the design_approach String field, delete the old hand-rolled impl vcs::DocumentDsl block, and confirm the crate's full test suite (parse/print round trips) still passes with cargo test/clippy.
